header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.tamil_translation: way? How do I come to know this?” a man asked. “If you hear your neighbours say, ‘You have behaved well’, then you have certainly done good! If you hear your neighbours say, ‘You have behaved badly’, then you have certainly done evil”, the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمنِ بْنِ اَبِيْ قُرَادٍ ﵁ اَنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ تَوَضَّاَ يَوْمًا، فَجَعَلَ اَصْحَابُهُ يَتَمَسَّحُوْنَ بِوَضُوْئِهِ، فَقَالَ لَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مَايَحْمِلُكُمْ عَلَي هذَا؟ قَالُوْا: حُبُّ اللهِ وَرَسُوْلِهِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: مَنْ سَرَّهُ اَنْ يُحِبَّ اللهَ وَرَسُوْلُهَ اَوْ يُحِبَّهُ اللهُ وَرَسُوْلُهُ فَلْيَصْدُقْ حَدِيْثَهُ اِذَا حَدَّثَ، وَلْيُؤَدِّ اَمَانَتَهُ اِذَا اؤْتُمِنَ، وَلْيُحْسِنْ جِوَارَ مَنْ جَاوَرَهُ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البيهقي في شعب الايمان مشكوة المصابيح رقم:٤٩٩٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdur-Rahman ibn Abi Qurad (RA) says: One day, when the Prophet ﷺ was making Wudu, the Companions of the Prophet ﷺ wiped the water of Wudu falling from the blessed body of the Prophet ﷺ over their faces and bodies. When Rasulullah ﷺ asked, “What made you do this?”, they said, “Love for Allah and His Messenger made us do this.” The Prophet ﷺ said, “Whoever wishes to love Allah Ta'ala and His Messenger, or wishes that Allah Ta'ala and His Messenger should love him, should speak only the truth when he speaks, and when something is entrusted to him as an Amanah, he should fulfil it in the proper way. And he should treat his neighbour well.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: مَازَالَ جِبْرِيْلُ يُوْصِيْنِيْ
